purpose: Analyze complete paginated current-window evidence first and use history only as secondary trend context.

evidence_contract.current_grouped_errors: Primary complete paginated current-window evidence. All semantic families are visible when evidence_complete=true.
evidence_contract.history: Secondary context from previous_analysis, grouped_error_diff, and source-coverage comparison. It cannot replace or override current evidence.
evidence_contract.source_coverage: Scope metadata used to decide whether current and historical evidence are comparable.

decision_rules: Use history only after the current review. Make trend claims only for comparable scope and never preserve historical severity by inertia.
Return final_report when complete current evidence supports the report and history adds only explainable trend context.
